name: mind-diary
description: Use self-describing hosted Mind Diary MCP tools, with optional advanced workflow guidance and a separate macOS exact-file companion.

interface.shortDescription: Use Personal and shared Minds by their topics.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to the Mind Diary UAT pilot with OAuth. Hosted MCP tools are self-describing for ordinary discovery, read, exact-revision file, history, validation and changeset workflows; the bundled skill is optional advanced guidance, not a prerequisite. Site modes determine read/write access and descriptions determine topics for automatic use. Personal Mind without a description is used only when you ask. The skill adds provenance-sensitive multi-Mind and incremental typed OKF workflows. Its separate macOS companion guidance covers one explicitly selected local file and exact size/SHA-256 downloads without claiming support on other hosts.
